notes: Adds reliable keyboard Done handling and explicit keyboard dismissal for every Speedtest+ controls action while retaining the original blue-leading, gray-following gauge animation, all profiles/themes/results features, and the full finite non-negative custom-speed range.

ios.notes: Fixes the iOS native optional-permission onboarding path when Continue or Next has lost its Swift target. Speedtest+ removes its custom surfaces while setup is visible, restores only the missing stock button action, and never grants or fabricates a system permission. The native consent flow, provider/server selection, and remote submission remain untouched. This IPA is unsigned and must be signed before sideloading.
